name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio: Gareth Llewellyn's journey in motorsport began in the Welsh valleys, tinkering with engines in his father's garage. A keen interest in engineering led him to a degree, followed by a stint at Cosworth, where he honed his skills in engine development. He then transitioned to race engineering, working his way up through various teams before finally landing the role of Team Principal at Team Penske. Gareth believes in fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives, emphasizing data-driven decisions balanced with driver feedback. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to extract the best from his team, even in challenging circumstances.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Gareth is a man of average height with a weathered face that reflects years spent in the paddock.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas, regardless of the setting.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of Earl Grey tea precisely at 3 PM every day.
